entities.name: Piotr Dunin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Piotr Dunin was a Polish knight and leader of the Malbork branch of the Teutonic Order, serving as the Starost of Malbork from 1478–1484 and castellan of Sieradz from 1478. He played a crucial role in the defense of the Prussian region against the Livonian Confederation.

Dunin's leadership was instrumental in the establishment of a strong military presence in the region, which helped to maintain the Order's influence in the area.

The legacy of Piotr Dunin extends beyond his military campaigns, as he also worked to promote the economic and cultural development of the region.

In the annals of history, Piotr Dunin stands as a testament to the enduring power of Polish leadership in the face of adversity.
